briefdescription.para: Get the alignment of this section.
Whether this section contains data, not instructions.
Whether this section contains BSS uninitialized data.
Whether this section will be placed in the text segment, according to the Berkeley size format.

detaileddescription.para: This is true if the section is allocatable, and contains either code or readonly data.

briefdescription.para: Whether this section will be placed in the data segment, according to the Berkeley size format.

detaileddescription.para: This is true if the section is allocatable and contains data (e.g. PROGBITS), but is not text.

briefdescription.para: Whether this section is a debug section.
Returns the related section if this section contains relocations.

detaileddescription.para: The returned section may or may not have applied its relocations.

briefdescription.para: This is a value type class that represents a single section in the list of sections in the object file.
